name: Robert S. Morris
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Lewisville, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: An attorney at Hammerle Morris Law Firm, located in Lewisville, Texas, Robert S. Morris offers comprehensive legal counsel across a broad range of practice areas, including estate planning, probate litigation, business law, banking law and real estate matters. His practice also encompasses contracts and agreements, entity formation, guardianship, elder law and issues involving Medicare. With decades of experience, he assists individuals, families and businesses in navigating complex legal matters with practical and effective solutions.

Mr. Morris has a strong background in both civil and criminal law. Early in his career, he served as a prosecutor and was elected by his peers to the board of directors of the Texas District and County Attorneys Association, where he served from 1983 to 1985. In 1986, he was appointed First Assistant District Attorney for the 118th Judicial District, further strengthening his leadership skills and courtroom experience. This foundation continues to inform his strategic approach to litigation and dispute resolution.

Throughout the course of his career, Mr. Morris has handled a wide variety of cases, guiding clients through every stage of the legal process, from initial planning and negotiation to litigation when necessary. He is known for his thorough preparation, attention to detail and commitment to achieving favorable outcomes tailored to his clients’ goals.

Mr. Morris earned his Bachelor of Arts from Johns Hopkins University in 1974 and his Juris Doctor from the University of Texas School of Law in 1977. He is admitted to practice in Texas, as well as before the U.S. District Courts for the Eastern, Northern, Southern and Western Districts of Texas; the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 5th Circuit; and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit. He is an active member of the legal community, and he belongs to WealthCounsel, the National Academy of Elder Law Attorneys, the Texas Association of Mediators and the State Bar of Texas.
honors: Texas Super Lawyer, Thompson Reuters Award, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017
